title: Banlist snapshot
description: One historical Forbidden/Limited list as it took effect on a given date. Banlists are format-independent data: several formats may reference the same snapshot.

id.description: Canonical id, e.g. tcg-2010-03. Matches the file path data/banlists/<region>/<yyyy>-<mm>.json.

superseded_by_date.description: Date the next list took effect, if known. null when unknown or still current.

supersedes.description: id of the previous list in the same region, when that list exists in this repository.

changed.description: true if this entry changed relative to the previous list (new to the list, moved category). Optional annotation for readers; not used by the build.

entries.description: Cards not listed are unlimited (3 copies). Statuses map to lflist counts: forbidden=0, limited=1, semilimited=2.
